SELECT AVG(group_rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(group_rate - benchmark) AS avg_margin_above_benchmark
FROM (
  SELECT AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS group_rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS t ON t.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  GROUP BY t.riskeval
) AS rates
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT AVG(group_rate) AS benchmark
  FROM (
    SELECT AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS group_rate
    FROM scans AS s
    JOIN sites AS t ON t.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
    GROUP BY t.riskeval
  ) AS all_rates
) AS b
WHERE group_rate > benchmark
